artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p>3$ be a prime and let $a$ be a positive integer. Define the second-order Catalan number (of the first kind) by
$$C_k^{(2)}=\binom{3k}{k}\frac{1}{2k+1}=\binom{3k}{k}-2\binom{3k}{k-1},$$
let $\binom{3k}{k,k,k}=\dfrac{(3k)!}{(k!)^3}$ be the central trinomial-type multinomial, and let $B_n(x)$ denote the $n$-th Bernoulli polynomial. For an integer $n$ and prime $p$, write $\left(\frac{n}{p}\right)$ for the Legendre/Jacobi symbol when applicable; here the symbols $(p^a)$ and $(p^{a-1})$ denote the Jacobi symbols $\left(\frac{p^a}{3}\right)$ and $\left(\frac{p^{a-1}}{3}\right)$ respectively, and $(p)=\left(\frac{p}{3}\right)$.

Prove or disprove the following three congruences:

(i) $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{p^a-1}\frac{\binom{3k}{k,k,k}}{27^k}\equiv \left(\frac{p^a}{3}\right)-\left(\frac{p^{a-1}}{3}\right)\frac{p^2}{3}\,B_{p-2}\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)\pmod{p^3}.$

(ii) $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{p^a-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}\,C_k^{(2)}}{27^k}\equiv \left(\frac{p^a}{3}\right)-2\left(\frac{p^{a-1}}{3}\right)p^2\,B_{p-2}\!\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)\pmod{p^3}.$

(iii) $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}(4k+1)\,\frac{\binom{2k}{k}\,C_k^{(2)}}{27^k}\equiv \left(\frac{p}{3}\right)\pmod{p^4}.$
